name: Phlebotomy Technician
summary:
Phlebotomy Technician is an immersive Virtual Reality (VR) training application developed to provide students with practical, hands-on experience in essential phlebotomy procedures.
Through interactive VR simulations, students can practice blood collection techniques, become familiar with phlebotomy equipment, and develop an understanding of the procedures and practices involved in safe and effective blood sample collection.
This application is an integral part of the Immerse Learn Phlebotomy Technician Cer
